commodities.name: Cashew

visualObservation.note: Mixed nuts and dried-fruit mixture, not isolated cashew kernels. Misleading hero for this commodity.
visualObservation.method: Visual inspection of the stored local binary; not a licensing or botanical certification

commodities.shortDescription: Cashew is offered as an enquiry-led tree-nut commodity. Kernel grade and form are confirmed with the buyer, not listed as a shop SKU.
commodities.description: Cashew (Anacardium occidentale) is commonly discussed as kernels for food use. In-shell nuts versus kernels, and any size or colour grade, are specified in the procurement request. This page does not publish prices, stock, or a standard pack size.

commodities.name: Cocoa

heroMedia.alt: Representative photo of cocoa beans in an opened pod — not an Almahbub farm

visualObservation.note: Image renders with severe dark/red blocks and does not provide a clear cocoa subject. Replace after source and decoder review.
visualObservation.method: Visual inspection of the stored local binary; not a licensing or botanical certification

commodities.shortDescription: Cocoa is an enquiry-led commodity. Beans versus further-processed forms are confirmed with the buyer.
commodities.description: Cocoa (Theobroma cacao) is commonly discussed as beans. Liquor, butter, cake, or other processed forms are only in scope when the buyer names them. This page does not publish origin lists, bean-count grades, or prices. Use Request a Quote to describe the form you need.

commodities.name: Ginger

heroMedia.alt: Representative photo of a pile of fresh ginger rhizomes

visualObservation.note: Fresh ginger rhizomes are clearly visible; description permits fresh or dried form.
visualObservation.method: Visual inspection of the stored local binary; not a licensing or botanical certification

commodities.shortDescription: Ginger is an enquiry-led spice/root commodity. Fresh or dried form is confirmed with the buyer.
commodities.description: Ginger (Zingiber officinale) may be discussed as fresh rhizomes or as dried/split material, depending on the requirement. This page does not assume a single commercial form, medicinal claim, or origin list. Share the form you need in the procurement request.

commodities.name: Hibiscus

heroMedia.alt: Representative photo of dried hibiscus (bissap) flowers

visualObservation.note: Red calyces and harvested stems visible; title and description refer to hibiscus. Cleaner commodity-focused image recommended.
visualObservation.method: Visual inspection of the stored local binary; not a licensing or botanical certification

commodities.shortDescription: Hibiscus is offered as an enquiry-led botanical commodity, typically discussed as dried calyces.
commodities.description: Hibiscus sabdariffa is commonly traded as dried calyces used in herbal infusions. Fresh flowers versus dried material, and any cutting or packing preference, are confirmed during enquiry. We do not publish unsupported origin, volume, or laboratory claims here.

commodities.name: Sesame Seeds

heroMedia.alt: Representative photo of sesame seeds in a spoon on a white surface

visualObservation.note: Small pale sesame seeds on a spoon are consistent with the commodity and seed description.
visualObservation.method: Visual inspection of the stored local binary; not a licensing or botanical certification

commodities.shortDescription: Sesame seed is an oilseed commodity discussed through enquiry. Grades and form are confirmed with the buyer — not as a priced SKU on this website.
commodities.description: Sesame (Sesamum indicum) is traded as seed. Hulled, unhulled, white, or mixed lots are specified during enquiry rather than assumed on this page. Almahbub Integrated Export handles sesame as an enquiry-led commodity: inspect the information here, then submit a procurement request so commercial terms can be confirmed.

commodities.name: Shea

heroMedia.alt: Representative photo of a shea nut (Vitellaria paradoxa seed)

visualObservation.note: Reddish nuts with dark fibrous patches; botanical identity is not confidently confirmed as shea. Require verified source identification.
visualObservation.method: Visual inspection of the stored local binary; not a licensing or botanical certification

commodities.shortDescription: Shea is an enquiry-led oilseed commodity. Nuts, kernels, or butter are confirmed with the buyer — this page does not assume a single form.
commodities.description: Shea comes from Vitellaria paradoxa. Trade discussions may cover nuts, kernels, or shea butter depending on the requirement. Form, packaging, and quality expectations are agreed through the procurement request. Representative imagery on this page is not an Almahbub farm or processing facility.

commodities.name: Soybean

visualObservation.note: Pale rounded seeds with visible hilum are consistent with soybean imagery and seed description.
visualObservation.method: Visual inspection of the stored local binary; not a licensing or botanical certification

commodities.shortDescription: Soybean is an enquiry-led oilseed/pulse commodity. Grade and end-use are confirmed with the buyer.
commodities.description: Soybean (Glycine max) is discussed as seed for food, crush, or other uses named in the enquiry. This page does not publish crush capacity, export volume, genetically modified / non-GM claims, or a destination list. Tell us the specification you need in the procurement request.
